2608.24252.title: SA-Bench: Evaluating Semantic Alignment in LLM-Based Paper Reproduction
2608.24252.paper_summary: LLM agents can generate paper reproduction code, yet often produce scientifically unfaithful implementations. We define this failure mode as semantic drift, where generated code silently diverges from the paper's specifications. We introduce SemanticAlign-Bench(SA-Bench), a diagnostic benchmark covering 30 papers from ICLR, ICML and NeurIPS 2025. For each paper, we decompose its specifications into atomic and verifiable implementation claims, which we call Semantic Alignment Units (SAUs) and evaluate repositories along four diagnostic dimensions spanning numerical, methodological, protocol and ordering drift. In total, we construct 1,491 SAUs across five ML domains and evaluate 12 generator configurations (4 models $\times$ 3 scaffolds). Even the strongest configuration (Claude+PaperCoder) achieves a mean SAU score of only 0.301 out of 1.0, with an overall mean of 0.221 across 360 evaluations. A failure taxonomy reveals that agents attempt most requirements but implement them incorrectly, with implementation mismatch and stubs accounting for the majority of zero-scored claims. Our analysis further indicates that scaffolds optimized for executability provide limited leverage for scientific reproduction; narrowing the gap requires scaffolds that prioritize semantic specification verification. The benchmark, annotations and evaluation pipeline are publicly available.
2608.24252.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理可以生成論文重現代碼，但經常產生科學上不忠實的實現。我們將這種失敗模式定義為語義漂移，其中生成的代碼默默地偏離了論文的規範。我們介紹了 SemanticAlign-Bench(SA-Bench)，這是一個診斷基準，涵蓋了來自 ICLR、ICML 和 NeurIPS 2025 的 30 篇論文。對於每篇論文，我們將其規範分解為原子和可驗證的實現聲明，我們稱之為語義對齊單元 (SAUs)，並沿著數值、方法論、協議和排序漂移四個診斷維度評估代碼庫。總體而言，我們在五個機器學習領域構建了 1,491 個 SAUs，並評估了 12 種生成器配置（4 個模型 × 3 個腳手架）。即使是最強的配置 (Claude+PaperCoder) 的平均 SAU 得分也僅為 0.301（滿分 1.0），在 360 次評估中整體平均為 0.221。失敗分類法顯示，代理嘗試滿足大多數要求，但實現不正確，實現不匹配和存根佔據了大多數零得分聲明。我們的分析進一步表明，為可執行性優化的腳手架對科學重現的幫助有限；縮小差距需要優先考慮語義規範驗證的腳手架。該基準、註釋和評估管道均可公開獲得。
